prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1352; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which their vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. They reported immediate onset of low back pain radiating into the left buttock without numbness, tingling, or weakness in the lower extremities. Neck pain and headache were denied. On examination, there was paraspinal muscle tenderness over the lumbar region with restricted lumbar flexion and extension, but neurological examination was intact, with normal strength, sensation, and reflexes in both lower extremities. Straight leg raise was negative bilaterally. No signs of acute fracture or instability were identified, and no imaging was ordered at this stage given the absence of red flag features.

Treatment consisted of soft tissue therapy, a short course of muscle relaxant and anti-inflammatory medication, and instruction in gentle activity and graded return to normal routine. The patient was advised to avoid heavy lifting and prolonged sitting for the first week.

At the second visit, the patient reported partial improvement in pain and better tolerance of daily activities. Range of motion had improved, and tenderness was reduced. The patient was discharged to self-directed home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms worsened or new neurological symptoms developed. Prognosis for full recovery is good.
